name: gmail
title: Gmail
description: A Gmail mailbox read over IMAP and sent through SMTP using an app password from the environment.

address.label: Gmail address
address.hint: Optional when GMAIL_ADDRESS is set. The app password is read only from GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD and is never stored on the source.

imap_host.label: IMAP host
imap_host.hint: host[:port]; imap://host:port for a plain (non-TLS) connection

smtp_host.label: SMTP host
smtp_host.hint: host[:port]; smtp://host:port for a plain (non-TLS) connection
